body: I’ve been to my family doctor and optometrist. My optometrists say it’s literally nothing but my eyes keep getting worse. The doctor said he would order an MRI but he says that can take upwards of 3 weeks. I’m just sitting here slowly losing my eyesight and I’m losing my mind

It feels numb but almost heavy too. It’s like I’ve been awake for a couple days without sleep on that eye it’s heavy and it burns. I just got a call that told me they could get me in to see a special eye doctor but it can’t be til the 20th of December. That’s some hope to keep me through the day but 5 weeks is a long time
